name: BOT_ATTACK
description: Automated bot attempting to exploit game mechanics or APIs

tasks.title: Triage
tasks.description: Confirm alert is a true positive; check affected game servers

tasks.title: Contain
tasks.description: Block offending IPs at firewall; flag player account

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.description: Analyse traffic patterns; identify exploit method

tasks.title: Remediate
tasks.description: Patch exploited endpoint; update bot detection rules

tasks.title: Report
tasks.description: Document incident; export IOCs to MISP

tasks.title: Close
tasks.description: Confirm resolution; update playbook if needed

name: ACCOUNT_COMPROMISE
description: Suspected unauthorised access to player or staff account

tasks.title: Triage
tasks.description: Confirm login anomaly; check geolocation and device fingerprint

tasks.title: Contain
tasks.description: Force password reset; revoke active sessions; lock account

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.description: Review login history; check for data access or exfiltration

tasks.title: Notify
tasks.description: Inform player if personal data was accessed (GDPR consideration)

tasks.title: Remediate
tasks.description: Enable MFA; update detection thresholds

tasks.title: Report
tasks.description: Document incident; export IOCs to MISP

tasks.title: Close
tasks.description: Confirm account secured; update playbook

name: SOCIAL_ENGINEERING
description: Social engineering attempt targeting staff or players

tasks.title: Triage
tasks.description: Confirm report; identify targeted user and method

tasks.title: Contain
tasks.description: Isolate affected account; block malicious domain or sender

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.description: Trace attack chain; identify what data was targeted

tasks.title: Escalate
tasks.description: Notify L3 IR Lead if player data was at risk

tasks.title: Remediate
tasks.description: Security awareness comms to all staff

tasks.title: Report
tasks.description: Document incident; export IOCs to MISP

tasks.title: Close
tasks.description: Confirm no further risk; update playbook

name: DDOS_INFRASTRUCTURE
description: Volumetric or application-layer attack against game servers

tasks.title: Triage
tasks.description: Confirm attack type and affected services

tasks.title: Contain
tasks.description: Enable rate limiting; activate DDoS mitigation

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.description: Identify attack vectors and source IPs

tasks.title: Escalate
tasks.description: Notify L3 IR Lead and management if matchmaking is down

tasks.title: Remediate
tasks.description: Null-route attack traffic; restore services

tasks.title: Report
tasks.description: Document incident; export IOCs to MISP

tasks.title: Close
tasks.description: Post-incident review; update runbook
